experiment: Creep-recovery (load-unload) replay of jev-corpus RSI round 3 (refs/ corpus)

scoring.rubric: 12 NSS axes, >=2 distinct evidence hits -> 1, prefer-0; quotes recorded per credited axis
scoring.intra_scorer_agreement_on_5_base_docs: 60/60 axes identical between first pass and independent rescore

audits.matrix: M10 (load: 9 of 10 documented flips applied; 1 collision - round11-ledger-state x assumption_set already credited by the re-scoring)
M_persist (5 edited docs' rows replaced by blind independent head-state scores)

audits.note: identical to M0 (60/60); audit input hash identical -> cached leg

F1_scorer_variance.statement: replayed baseline dBc -16.88 vs recorded -11.11 on the IDENTICAL corpus at the identical SHA; the sign gate judged a +0.64 effect inside a +/-5.8 grader-pass noise band

F2_load_sign.statement: load leg moved +2.57 (toward null), same sign as round 3's recorded +0.64: in this frame, cell flips mechanically move dBc toward the null regardless of text quality

F3_recovery_trivial.statement: under a deterministic scorer the text-revert unload returns the matrix exactly; R is trivially 1 and cannot separate edit classes

F4_persistence.statement: every applied flip survives blind independent re-grading of the loaded text, and the measured level moves FURTHER from baseline (+3.22), not back toward it: round 3's axis-fills were substantive enough to persist; the regression was the corpus-level response direction, not cell fragility

F5_prediction_vs_realized.statement: the lens overpredicted per-candidate dBc effect by ~2 orders of magnitude; sum |predicted - realized| across the round is 102.9 dBc-units - the dissipation metric the outcomes ledger was designed to catch

instrument_implications: The discriminating measurement is persistence-under-independent-re-grading, not text-revert R (jev 0.92). /api/jev/corpus/visco should lead with a re-grade leg.
The per-cycle dBc sign gate must pin the scoring prompt and re-score only edited rows (AGENT.md lesson 5), now quantified: grader-pass offset 5.77 dBc vs effect size 0.64 (jev 0.89).
Hysteresis (predicted vs realized) belongs on the outcomes ledger rollup; round 3's 102.9 dBc-units of prediction dissipation is the shape of the metric.
Recovery fraction R becomes non-trivial only with a rate-dependent or stochastic scorer; deterministic scoring collapses the elastic/plastic distinction into the persistence test.
